```{ojs}
// Import the class from the external JS module
import {EchoInput} from "./bsui_widgets.js";

// Instantiate the widget
viewof echo = new EchoInput({
  placeholder: "Type something…",
  oninput: v => console.log("Callback:", v)
});

// Mount into a DOM container
echo.mount(html`<div></div>`);
```
